exhaustive_start_verification.scope: 逐可採起點窮舉（verify_exhaustive）；純窗口型 WINDOW_ONLY_ANALYTIC 之 K＝窗口長度；採用值＝各實例量測取最大

meta.reliability: K <= eval_start/2（ground truth 前史 ≥ 2K）者方入採用值
meta.principle: Minimum warmup K such that max|test - infinite_history_gt| over the eval window is less than THRESHOLD * max(P75(|gt|), std(gt)); ground truth finite but test non-finite = inf.
meta.usage: K = ceil(max(params[k] for k in period_keys) * recommended_factor); period_keys 為空者取 k；cumulative 無收斂點（K＝0）。見 momentum/FeatureEngineering/atomic/warmup_lookup.py
